drafts.passage: Calloway-Sum outperformed Pellam-Sum on ROUGE-L F1 in all four held-out text domains, with advantages of 1.5 percentage points on Lindqvist-Sci (36.4 vs. 34.9), 1.3 on Corbin-Legal (33.1 vs. 31.8), 1.5 on Ashdown-Meet (29.7 vs. 28.2), and 1.2 on Gable-Reviews (31.5 vs. 30.3). These held-out advantages (1.2–1.5 percentage points) were similar in magnitude to the in-domain advantage of 1.2 percentage points on Ravenmoor News (41.8 vs. 40.6). Calloway-Sum also exceeded the Lead-3 extractive baseline in every held-out domain, with margins of 4.6 percentage points on Gable-Reviews (31.5 vs. 26.9), 4.7 on Lindqvist-Sci (36.4 vs. 31.7), 5.2 on Corbin-Legal (33.1 vs. 30.5), and 7.3 on Ashdown-Meet (29.7 vs. 22.4). However, no statistical tests were reported, so these differences are descriptive only and their significance is not established.
